package.name: LiveSectionAnalyzer
package.description: Interactive, real-time section analysis for FreeCAD: move the section plane with a slider or a 3D gizmo, with GPU clipping, hatch, per-object colors and a fast mesh-based section for large assemblies. Freeze keeps a real-geometry copy.
